_note: Documents which environment variables the payment rails read at runtime. This file MUST NEVER contain an actual secret value — only variable names and non-secret descriptions/defaults. Copy the variable names into a real .env (see .env.example) and set the values there, outside version control.

required_env_vars.POLICY_SECRET: HMAC secret for SpendIntent signing. Never committed. Minimum 32 random characters; the policy engine refuses to start without one.
required_env_vars.AGENT_PRIVATE_KEY: Throwaway signing key the policy engine uses for the execution agent's EIP-3009 authorizations. Never given to the execution agent process.
required_env_vars.RELAYER_PRIVATE_KEY: Gas-funded relayer key. Only required when SETTLE_MODE=onchain.
required_env_vars.RPC_URL: Avalanche RPC endpoint (Fuji for testing, mainnet for production).
required_env_vars.CARD_GATEWAY_URL: StraitsX reference gateway REST base URL, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:4010.
required_env_vars.WALLET_TECHSTORE: Overrides the dev_wallet in fintech/policy_config.json for the techstore merchant.
required_env_vars.WALLET_GADGETHUB: Overrides the dev_wallet in fintech/policy_config.json for the gadgethub merchant.
required_env_vars.WALLET_CHEAP: Overrides the dev_wallet in fintech/policy_config.json for the cheapdealsstore merchant.
required_env_vars.WALLET_BARGAIN: Overrides the dev_wallet in fintech/policy_config.json for the bargainbin merchant.
